title: Runes
changes: Runes now drop from monsters and chests: ten carved stones in three ranks (Lesser, plain, Greater).
Set a rune into a weapon or a piece of armour: open the bag, click the rune, then click the item. Rare and Legendary items have two sockets.
Weapon runes may fire when you hit or cast (fire bursts, freezing, poison, chain lightning, life and mana back); armour runes when you are struck (thorns, wards, healing, chilling the attacker).
Click a rune stone on an item to take it out again: the rune comes back to your bag whole.
